about: teacher_training Amendment 3 (reports/plans/2026-10-23_plan_teacher-training.md -> 'Amendment 3: a LoRA teacher'; class 3/4, user 2026-10-26 'implement the amendments'). Tasks emoticon, r1_t534_v369, r0_t352_v310. The teacher is E9's LoRA regenerated in-job: rank 8 on all 24 matrices, B = 0 and A ~ N(0, 1/d_in) at seed 0, Adam 1e-3, 1,000 steps, arm A's loss, batch 32 and clip 1 (finetune.finetune_lora_arm_a); delta-W = B A per matrix at step 1000. Students: E34's arms A (the task's training windows, arm_a_loss's weighting, Adam 1e-5, batch 32) and B (Pile train rows from 32,768, 8,192 rows, batch 8 of 512 tokens, plain mean KL, Adam 1e-5), 1,000 steps, batch-order seed 0, scored at steps 100 and 1000 through E34's harness. E34's predictions.json stands unedited. Filed before any run

controls.C1: first, alone: W0 under the Pile harness (256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary, adversary seeds 0, 1, 2), faith_score.w0_check, as E34. Expected: pass, floor about 0.075 on an H100. Fails: stop, nothing trained
controls.G1: the emoticon LoRA teacher, before any student: at step 1000 its held-out P(target) within 0.01 of E9's 0.9999, KL elsewhere within 0.005 of E9's 0.0048, size (rel_norm_max) within 0.005 of E9's 0.0900 (lora_plateau.json checkpoints['1000']['eval']; the same recipe and seed), and its scaled adjoint state's held-out P(target) within 0.05 of E14's 0.063 (lora_split.json part2.lora24['1000'].adjoint, p_cells T1). All absolute. Fails: stop with the four numbers (the recipe does not reproduce)
controls.task_gate: per task, after its teacher's reading: a LoRA teacher with held-out P(target) < 0.9 at step 1000 is reported (its reading, gap, do-nothing and adjoint states) and its arms skipped; the run goes on to the next task. A skip, not a stop: r0 and r1 have no LoRA reference

expected.LoRA teacher, emoticon: E9 at step 1000: P 0.9999, KL elsewhere 0.0048, size 0.0900. Its do-nothing state's adversarial ratio about 1.04 (E14, L40; not gated), its scaled adjoint state's P 0.063 (E14)
expected.LoRA teachers, r0 and r1: no reference; the task gate reads them. r0's trigger is the hardest (E34's teachers 0.94)
expected.W0: P(target) 0.004 emoticon, 0.15 r0, 0.04 r1; every ratio 1; teacher gap = the LoRA's whole effect (about 5 nats on emoticon: W0's P 0.004 at the trigger)
expected.arm A: as E34's arm-A copies: P 0.92-1.0 at both steps, 'pass' at 0.93-1.30, gap under 4% of W0's
expected.arm B: as E34's arm-B copies at step 1000: P 0.90-0.98 and 'pass'; at step 100 0.34-0.85, still learning
expected.damage: the LoRA's own KL elsewhere is about 0.005, below E34's teachers' 0.007-0.078, so the student's damage / the teacher's is not read as a ratio (E34's P6); both are reported

measurements.adjoint: the scaled adjoint state is read without the Pile harness (as E34): P(target), teacher gap, damage, size, Delta's share
measurements.cosine: finetune.cosines(student delta-W, LoRA delta-W) per matrix and over the 24 matrices concatenated (float64), for the step-1000 arm-A and arm-B students. References per task: the scaled adjoint state of the same delta-W (split.adjoint_state, Sigma = W0's input second moments on the task's training windows) and the null, finetune.random_direction(delta-W, seed 0), expected about 0 (|cos| < 0.01). Blind to the part of delta-W that does nothing on the data; positive control: arm A's cosine against the null's
measurements.seven numbers: per state as E34 (run.record): adversarial and stochastic ratios to this job's W0 with faith_score.state_verdict, held-out P(target), teacher gap, damage elsewhere, size, Delta's share; definitions, expected W0 and do-nothing values and blind-to lines as in predictions.json. Both scored steps (100, 1000) are read through the harness, so P at step 100 is the harness reading as in E34
measurements.teacher reading: the LoRA's own held-out P(target), KL elsewhere and size at step 1000 from finetune_lora_arm_a's checkpoint eval (E9's measurement); its step-100 P(target) logged
